# Lumifin

> Lumifin is a French fintech that lets European travellers pay like a local in Southeast Asia by scanning local QR codes (PromptPay in Thailand, VietQR in Vietnam, QRIS in Indonesia) directly from a EUR account, with zero hidden fees and no FX markup.

Lumifin is operated by LumiFin SAS, headquartered at 50 rue Anatole France, 92290 Châtenay-Malabry, France. The product is currently waitlist-only and aimed at Europeans travelling to Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://lumifin.io/): Product overview, hero, waitlist signup
- [FAQ](https://lumifin.io/faq): How QR payments work, fees, supported countries, security, account onboarding
- [Team](https://lumifin.io/team): Founders and team behind Lumifin
- [Security](https://lumifin.io/security): Bank-grade encryption, GDPR compliance, two-factor authentication
- [Compare](https://lumifin.io/compare): How Lumifin differs from Revolut, Wise, and traditional bank cards
- [Careers](https://lumifin.io/careers): Open roles
- [Privacy](https://lumifin.io/privacy): GDPR-compliant privacy policy
